scope_definitions.CALIBRATION: fixed untrained full-training RMS constants; no outcomes
scope_definitions.FT8_QUERY: fixed first at most eight current-training patients; NOT the full training cohort or independent cases
scope_definitions.FT_GRAD: complete current-training risk set; vector gradients accumulated over all microbatches
scope_definitions.FT_RISK: all current training rows; saved per-patient risk summaries
scope_definitions.IV_PAIR: epoch80 inner-validation direct paired-risk credits or frozen metrics
scope_definitions.IV_RISK: all current inner-validation rows; saved risk summaries
